referenceTraits: syncopated stop-start groove in the low register
chromatic tension against a tonic pedal
half-time drum backbone with controlled double kick
blues-inflected expressive lead over a thinned backing
dynamic hard-to-clean transition at the end of the piece

tracks.rationale: Ana riff ve dusuk-tel agirligi bu track'te. Drop D acik dusuk teli parcanin low-end'ini tasiyor.
Yalniz solo bolumunde var; oncesinde susmasi soloyu bir olay yapiyor.
Half-time omurga ve gecisleri tasiyor; akustik bolumde tamamen susuyor.
Kapanisin tamami; baska hicbir track o bolumde yazili degil.

motifs.rhythmSignature: attacks on 0, 3, 6, 10, 12 of a sixteenth grid; the rest empty
motifs.accentStructure: accents on 0, 6 and 12; the attacks between them choked
motifs.pitchContour: stays on scale degree 1; the low open string throughout
motifs.spaceCharacter: eleven of sixteen slots are silent, and the silence is the riff
motifs.rationale: 3+3+2 gruplamasi nabzi iki kez itip 4. vurusta geri oturuyor.

motifs.rhythmSignature: three sixteenths in a row landing on the beat before the bar ends
motifs.pitchContour: b3 - 2 - 1, a chromatic descent onto the tonic
motifs.spaceCharacter: fills a gap the cell left, then stops
motifs.rationale: Hucrenin cevap cumlesi; kromatik gerilim buradan geliyor.

sections.tonalJob: tonic pedal, no harmonic movement at all
sections.motifTransformation: stated plainly; the answer phrase arrives every second bar
sections.entryIntent: starts on the downbeat with no count-in
sections.exitIntent: lands on a held tonic the bridge can cut into
sections.linkToNext: the same attack points survive into the bridge

sections.tonalJob: tritone tension against the pedal, unresolved into the solo
sections.motifTransformation: same attack points, gaps closing, chromatic descent extended to the tritone
sections.entryIntent: cuts in on the held tonic with a crash
sections.linkToNext: the tritone is the question the solo answers

sections.tonalJob: resolves the tritone, peaks on the octave, lands on the tonic
sections.motifTransformation: the cell's rhythm becomes melody in the lead; the backing thins to its attack points
sections.entryIntent: the lead answers the bridge's unresolved tritone
sections.linkToPrevious: same rhythmic cell, now sung rather than chugged
sections.linkToNext: the tonic it lands on is the note the acoustic takes over

sections.tonalJob: the same tonic, held open, resolving to the minor third
sections.motifTransformation: the cell's attack points return plucked and quiet; the notes are new, the rhythm is the quotation
sections.entryIntent: takes over the tonic the solo left ringing
sections.exitIntent: left ringing, resolved but not cheerful
sections.linkToPrevious: common tone on the tonic, and the pulse is exactly half the heavy tempo

requestedTechniques.purpose: Pedal notayi bogup hucreye dur-kalk karakteri veriyor.
Son bar uzayan tonic ile bridge'e baglaniyor.
Kromatik gerilimi tritone'a tasiyan tek hareket.
Yazili b5 yerine blues rengini bend ile getiriyor.
Tepe noktasi: oktav tonige ulasip geri donuyor.
Tepe sonrasi oturan notayi canli tutuyor.

omittedRequests.reason: Eklenmedi. Low-end'i Drop D ritim gitarinin acik dusuk D teli tasiyor; mevcut pack'teki parmak basi distorted gitarin altinda tanim eklemeden bulanikliga katki yapardi. Dort track'lik bir mikste telefon hoparlorunde netlik agirliktan onemli.

Kismen karsilandi. Nota cesitliligi verildi (kick, snare, hat, open hat, crash, tom'lar) fakat motorda crash/ride/china ayni synth cymbal voice'una dusuyor, yani notasyon cesitliligi isitsel cesitlilige birebir cevrilmiyor. Yeni sample pack bu checkpoint'in kapsami disinda.
